adjudication: Keep every seed and failure. Instrument/calibration/representation failures do not automatically refute the TLI/TLIR core; only directly contradictory true-system behavior under actually claimed conditions does.
architecture: Hard-spiking temporal recurrent network, four recurrent spike blocks and exact integer spike events; no attention

data: scikit-learn digits native 8x8 10-class task, stratified 75/25 train/heldout split per run, selected first 96 heldout rows with fixed ordering
not_claimed: A new theorem applicable to all neural models
Full native GFG Core v3 validated record
Native TLI instruments original study direct reproduction
